coaching.title: Easy 5mi Z2 Rolling
coaching.message: Calendar has 5 miles easy, ~700ft of rolling vert, HR 138-150 (Zone 2, well under your 165 LTHR). Two weeks from Julian Alps, this is a taper session, not a fitness-building one -- keep it comfortable and conversational. Use the rolling terrain as a dress rehearsal for the alpine climbs: practice a steady power-hike cadence on the ups, quick relaxed turnover on the downs. If you're at altitude or heat in Lima today, let effort (not pace) set the intensity.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Short easy run means no in-run fueling needed -- water or light electrolytes is enough. Hold total carbs near your 220g/day baseline even as mileage drops this taper block; your legs still need glycogen to absorb the work you've already banked. Post-run, get 20-30g protein plus some carbs within the hour, especially useful today with a travel day (Lima departure) stacked on top of the run.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Load is low today, so recovery is mostly about protecting sleep around travel logistics (pack, leave for Lima this afternoon). Hydrate well before the flight/drive, do 5-10 min of mobility for hips and calves tonight, and prioritize 7-8 hours of sleep despite the schedule shuffle -- taper weeks are won in bed, not on the trail.

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: Two weeks out, the hardest discipline is doing less. Trust that the base and build work is already in your legs -- today's job is just to move well and stay sharp, not to chase extra fitness. Each rolling mile is a small rehearsal for the Julian Alps switchbacks: run it with the calm, patient mindset you'll need on race day.
